resources.string: Phone permission needed for satellite status
SMS permission is required to send text messages.
Phone State permission is needed to show the satellite network indicator.
How to test on One NZ satellite (New Zealand)

1. Use a compatible phone: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, Z Fold 6, Z Flip 6, or Oppo Find X8 Pro (more models being added).

2. Insert a One NZ SIM with a plan that includes satellite coverage.

3. Update to Android 15 or later to see the satellite network indicator.

4. Go to a rural or remote location with no cell tower coverage.

5. Step outside with a clear, unobstructed view of the sky.

6. Wait ~30 seconds for the satellite network to acquire. The banner above will change to "On satellite (non-terrestrial) network" when ready.

7. Enter a New Zealand mobile number and a short message, then tap Send SMS.

8. Satellite SMS supports standard SMS only — no MMS, RCS, or iMessage.

9. Delivery may take a minute or two depending on satellite pass overhead.
